payload.summary: Closed the final plan-review gaps: the production canary now follows the shipped UI, CI is triggered by a draft PR, deployment uses a detached exact-SHA checkout, and a tested validator enforces evidence completeness.
completed_work: Resolved the final four review findings
Revalidated strict OpenSpec and work-package contracts
Received an internal re-review with no remaining blockers or should-fix findings

decisions.title: Exercise the deployed form exactly once
decisions.rationale: The UI does not send a caller-provided idempotency header; a unique URL marker and one visible click prove the shipped path without expanding product scope.

decisions.title: Deploy from a detached checked SHA
decisions.rationale: Draft-PR CI plus Railway commit metadata creates an auditable identity chain from tested commit to active deployment.

decisions.title: Validate evidence content
decisions.rationale: Artifact existence alone cannot establish revision, rollback, operation, log, or retired-route acceptance outcomes.

next_steps: Commit and push the plan, then implement the work-package DAG test-first.

relevant_files.description: Executable CI, detached deployment, and one-shot canary sequence
Evidence validator and aligned result contracts
